final: WITH joined AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS desc_, CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) AS units, ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost AS diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code), grp AS (SELECT desc_, AVG(units) AS avg_units, AVG(diff) AS diff_avg FROM joined GROUP BY desc_), overall AS (SELECT AVG(diff_avg) AS overall_avg FROM grp WHERE diff_avg IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT g.desc_, g.avg_units, g.diff_avg, g.diff_avg - o.overall_avg AS dev FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.diff_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_units), AVG(diff_avg), AVG(dev) FROM kept
